(3,5-dihydroxyphenyl)acetyl-CoA 1,2-dioxygenase
(
EC
1.13.11.80
,
DpgC
) is an
enzyme
[
1
]
catalyses
the following
chemical reaction
(3,5-dihydroxyphenyl)acetyl-CoA + O
2
⇌ 2-(3,5-dihydroxyphenyl)-2-oxoacetate + CoA.
This enzyme is involved in the biosynthesis of the nonproteinogenic amino acid
(
S
)-3,5-dihydroxyphenylglycine
(Dpg) responsible of the production of
vancomycin
and
teicoplanin
antibiotics. It catalyzes the unusual conversion 3,5-dihydroxyphenylacetyl-CoA (DPA-CoA) to 3,5-dihydroxyphenylglyoxylate.
